quiz_1_question.eng: True or False: Reading with your child means reading the words in the book aloud.

quiz_1_feedback_1.eng:
❌ That’s incorrect. 

👂 While it’s fun to read the words aloud, it can also help to ask children questions and explore the story with them.

🔑 your child will practise saying new words and develop an interest in reading.

rows.text_1_facilitator: 4️⃣ Here are four more ways to help your child learn reading skills: Use Books to Learn, Notice Letters, Play Word Games, and Start Writing.

text_1_facilitator.eng: 4️⃣ Here are four more ways to help your child learn reading skills: Use Books to Learn, Notice Letters, Play Word Games, and Start Writing.

section_1_text.eng:
💡 Books with no words help with imagination, ideas, and learning new words. Together, name and describe what is in the pictures. 
⭐ Books with words help to understand letters, sounds, and what different words look like.
🎵 Focus on words that rhyme, repeat, and start with the same letter, like “big black boot.”
➡️ Point to each word and say it aloud to help your child recognise some of the letters and sounds!

section_2_text.eng:
👀 Look for letters everywhere, such as on signs and packages.
💡Point the letters out to your child and name them.
👂 Ask your child to find letters and name them, too!

section_3_text.eng:
🎵 Sing and rhyme with your child to help them learn about the different sounds that make words.
👋 Break up words into syllables. Clap with your child while saying each syllable - start with just 2!
🔄 Swap sounds or letters to make new words, like “cat, pat, mat.” Then, repeat the sounds that were changed: “c”, “p”, “m”
👀 Help your child identify “beginning,” “middle,” and “end” sounds - and letters that make these.
✅ Once they understand letters and sounds in different places in words, you can help them put the parts of a word together to make the whole word!

section_4_text.eng:
🧸🌷 Encourage your child to draw. They can start by drawing things they like, such as animals or flowers.
▶️ Next, show them how to draw shapes that look like letters: 🔵🔶
😃 Later, help them write simple letters. Start with the first letter of their name! 
🔄 Practise and add letters until they can write their whole name. Then learn letters in other words!

quiz_1_question.eng: Home activity! Can you draw or write with your child today? ⭐

quiz_1_feedback_1.eng: Excellent! Drawing and writing with your child is a great way to help them learn! 📝

quiz_1_feedback_2.eng: That’s okay. It’s not always possible to do this with your child. Try to find a bit of time to write with your child every day - it will help them learn! 📝
